Your appointment destination

What to know before visiting from Piestewa Peak.

Appointments from Piestewa Peak take place at 6022 N 16th St, Phoenix, AZ 85016. Call 602-607-5686 if you need help selecting a service or planning a group visit. The salon is open Monday–Saturday 9:30 AM–7 PM and Sunday 10 AM–5 PM; available booking times may end earlier. Free on-site parking is available. Check the current menu and booking flow for service choices and starting prices.

View current menu →

Route and arrival from Piestewa Peak

Navigate to the salon, not the recreation area.

SR-51, Lincoln Drive, Glendale Avenue, and nearby streets may affect the route from the Piestewa Peak area. Confirm that live navigation ends at Element Nail Bar — 16th Street, 6022 N 16th St.

Open Google Maps →

Plan your visit · Custom Nail Art

Translate the design reference into bookable work before leaving the mountain area.

A nail-art visit from Piestewa Peak should begin with the base system and the number of detailed nails, not a vague request for something similar to a photo. Identify whether the art sits on natural nails, a gel manicure, Builder Gel, or a new Gel-X set. Then specify the must-have motif, palette, finish, French or chrome elements, and any repairs. The artist can adapt scale and placement, but the reserved time must reflect the actual complexity. This planning makes the trip worthwhile without suggesting an Element storefront at the mountain.

Plan custom nail art →

Another option · Aprés Gel-X

Gel-X can provide the canvas, but it remains a separate full set.

If the design depends on extension length or a uniform shape, reserve Gel-X removal and replacement, desired length, and the art component together. Art time is not automatically included in a basic extension category.

Choose the pedicure experience first and add the intended finish or simple design where supported. Existing gel and repair needs belong in the booking notes.
